sections.title: Identification and habitat
sections.text: The catalogue entry Dactylis refers to Dactylis glomerata, orchard grass, a perennial bunchgrass about 0.5–1.2 m tall. It grows in meadows, pastures and roadsides and is widely used as forage.

sections.title: Panicle and spikelets
sections.text: Its branched panicle bears dense clusters of spikelets, often turned to one side. The plate shows this characteristic arrangement and a close-up of a spikelet. The fruit is a small caryopsis, as in other grasses.
